description.zh: 给项目改名。用户要求给项目改名、重命名或指定项目名称时使用；不填 project 则改当前对话所在的项目，填了按项目名或 id 定位。
description.en: Rename a project. Use when the user asks to rename a project or give it a name; without project it renames the current conversation's project, otherwise it locates the project by name or id.

project.description: 要改名的项目名称或 id（留空 = 当前项目）
name or id of the project to rename (empty = the current project)
